description: This Dart file defines a `SigmaTheme` class that provides theme configuration for a Flutter application. It constructs a custom `ThemeData` based on accent and neon secondary colors, setting various UI component styles such as app bar, buttons, cards, and text themes.

classes.name: SigmaTheme
classes.description: A utility class that builds and provides a custom Flutter theme based on input color hex strings.

methods.name: buildTheme
methods.description: Builds a ThemeData object with customized styling based on provided accent and neon secondary color hex strings.

methods.name: _textTheme
methods.description: Defines a custom TextTheme with specific font sizes, weights, and colors aligned with the color scheme.
